#Loading libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)

```

#Importing datasets and joining them
```{r}
english <- read.csv("../data/clean/caffeine_sensitivity_english_clean.csv") %>%
  filter(caff_intox_revised_13 == 4) %>%
  mutate(sample = "English") %>%
  select(sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

hungarian <- read.csv("../data/clean/caffeine_sensitivity_hungarian_clean.csv") %>%
  filter(if_all(
      all_of(paste0("caff_intox_revised_", 1:12)),
      ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
  mutate(caff_sens = factor(caff_sens, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = "Hungarian") %>%
  select(sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

caff_sens_invariance <- bind_rows(english, hungarian)
```
#Determining group order
```{r}
caff_sens_invariance$sample <- factor(
  caff_sens_invariance$sample,
  levels = c("Hungarian", "English"))

```
#Model specification
```{r}
bifactor_model_caff_sens <- '

  G =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  F1 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
        caff_intox_revised_4 +
        caff_intox_revised_6 
        

  F2 =~ caff_intox_revised_5 +
        caff_intox_revised_6 +
        caff_intox_revised_7 +
        caff_intox_revised_8 +
        caff_intox_revised_9 +
        caff_intox_revised_10 +
        caff_intox_revised_12

  G ~~ 0*F1
  G ~~ 0*F2
  F1 ~~ 0*F2
'

fit_bifactor_caff_sens <- cfa(
  bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE
  )


summary(
  fit_bifactor_caff_sens,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)


```

#Configural invariance
```{r}
ordinal_items <- paste0(
  "caff_intox_revised_",
  c(1:10, 12)
)

fit_configural <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  return.fit = TRUE
)

summary(fit_configural,fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

#Threshold invariance
```{r}
fit_thresholds <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds"),
  return.fit = TRUE
)

```

#Metric invariance
```{r}
fit_metric <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"),
  return.fit = TRUE
)
```

#Scalar invariance
##Fixing the scalar syntax (freeing the latent means)
```{r}
#Generating scalar syntax
scalar_syntax <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings", "intercepts")
)


syntax_str <- as.character(scalar_syntax)
cat(syntax_str)

# Freeing latent means in group 2
syntax_scalar_free_means <- syntax_str %>%
  str_replace("G ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "G ~ c(0, NA)*1") %>%
  str_replace("F1 ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "F1 ~ c(0, NA)*1") %>%
  str_replace("F2 ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "F2 ~ c(0, NA)*1")

fit_scalar <- cfa(
  syntax_scalar_free_means,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta"
)

```

#Strict invariance
##Setting parameterization "theta" in strict invariance
```{r}
# Applying parameterization to all 5 models when testing strict invariance
strict_syntax <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_caff_sens,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings", "intercepts", "residuals")
)

# Freeing the latent means 
syntax_strict_free_means <- as.character(strict_syntax) %>%
  str_replace("G ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "G ~ c(0, NA)*1") %>%
  str_replace("F1 ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "F1 ~ c(0, NA)*1") %>%
  str_replace("F2 ~ c\\(0, 0\\)\\*1", "F2 ~ c(0, NA)*1")

fit_strict <- cfa(
  syntax_strict_free_means,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  ordered = ordinal_items,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta"
)
```


#Comparing each model 
```{r}
# Fit indices (CFI, TLI, RMSEA, SRMR, etc.)
inv_summary@fit

# Differences in fit indices between consecutive models
inv_summary@fit.diff

# Scaled chi-square difference tests (DIFFTEST)
inv_summary@nested

```

#Comparison table
```{r}
models <- list(
  Configural = fit_configural,
  Thresholds = fit_thresholds,
  Metric     = fit_metric,
  Scalar     = fit_scalar,
  Strict     = fit_strict
)

fit_table <- sapply(models, function(m) {
  fitMeasures(m, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled", 
                   "cfi.scaled", "tli.scaled", "rmsea.scaled", "srmr"))}) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  mutate(
    delta_cfi   = cfi.scaled - lag(cfi.scaled),
    delta_tli   = tli.scaled - lag(tli.scaled),
    delta_rmsea = rmsea.scaled - lag(rmsea.scaled),
    delta_srmr  = srmr - lag(srmr)
  )

print(fit_table, digits = 3)

# Scaled chi-square difference tests (DIFFTEST)
lavTestLRT(fit_configural, fit_thresholds, fit_metric, fit_scalar, fit_strict)


```
